mapper.sql: SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_info u JOIN sys.user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id AND r.use_yn='Y' JOIN sys.role_menu_auth a ON a.role_id=r.role_id JOIN sys.menu m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id AND m.scrn_id=#{screenId} AND m.use_yn='Y' WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND u.user_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND (u.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR u.rsgn_dt > #{today}) AND a.inq_auth_yn='Y' AND a.contact_inq_auth_yn='Y'
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt > #{today}) THEN d.tel_no ELSE NULL END AS phone, CASE WHEN d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt > #{today}) THEN d.email_addr ELSE NULL END AS email, NOT(d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt > #{today})) AS masked FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id} AND EXISTS( AND #{purpose}='STAFF_OPERATION' AND ((r.role_id=4 AND r.data_scope_cd='PART' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_part up WHERE up.user_id=u.user_id AND up.bsn_part_id=d.bsn_part_id)) OR (r.role_id=5 AND r.data_scope_cd='PROJECT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn ag JOIN sys.user_prj up ON up.prj_id=ag.prj_id AND up.user_id=u.user_id WHERE ag.dev_id=d.dev_id AND ag.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND ag.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND ag.end_dt >= #{today}))))

SELECT CASE WHEN p.use_yn='Y' THEN p.chrg_tel_no ELSE NULL END AS phone,CASE WHEN p.use_yn='Y' THEN p.chrg_email_addr ELSE NULL END AS email,p.use_yn<>'Y' AS masked FROM mst.ptnr p WHERE p.ptnr_id=#{id} AND EXISTS( AND ((r.role_id=3 AND #{purpose}='BILLING_RECEIPT_PAYMENT' AND r.data_scope_cd='ALL') OR (r.role_id=4 AND #{purpose}='CONTRACT_SALES' AND r.data_scope_cd='PART' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prj.prj pr JOIN sys.user_part up ON up.bsn_part_id=pr.bsn_part_id AND up.user_id=u.user_id WHERE pr.cust_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id AND pr.use_yn='Y'))))
